subject: Mythology
title: Celtic Mythology in Video Games
description: A fast breakdown of Celtic Mythology in Video Games for builders.

hook.text: Some of the most acclaimed video games ever made draw directly from Celtic mythology and folklore.

buildup.text: The Witcher series draws from Slavic and Celtic folklore. Hellblade uses Celtic warrior myths to explore mental health.

discovery.text: Assassin's Creed Valhalla features druids, standing stones, and Celtic curses alongside its Viking storyline.

twist.text: Games let players live inside Celtic myths: exploring fairy mounds, fighting fomorians, and seeking magical cauldrons.

climax.text: Interactive storytelling brings Celtic myths to life in ways oral tradition never could.

punchline.text: Ancient druids told stories by firelight. Now players live them.

quiz.question: Which game uses Celtic mythology to explore mental health themes?
